fusions.name: Sporefall
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of spores 4 tiles ahead that deals 8 damage to everything in it. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Spreading Itch
fusions.desc: Sends a bite at the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage, with a 70% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Mending Mist
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Plague Vector
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.
